newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's Kepak Group to acquire Agra Trading.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Kepak Group to acquire Agra Trading.

text.p: Meat processing company Kepak Group said on Tuesday that it is to acquire the business and assets of Agra Trading Limited and its subsidiary Agra Meat Packers Limited, both units of Agra Investments S.A.

Agra Trading is one of the leading beef trading companies in Europe while Agra Meat Packers operates a modern facility in County Cork for the slaughtering, boning, processing, chilling, freezing and storing of beef, Kepak said in a statement.
"The Agra business fits neatly into the Kepak Group and our long term development plans," Kepak managing director Laim McGreal said. "It is complementary to our existing activities."
He said all contracts of employment would be honoured as part of the agreement.
Following the acquisition, Kepak will process 400,000 cattle and over 2.5 million lambs per annum at its facilities in Ireland and Britain.
